id: \bI'm a basic trainer with a Shadow Pokémon.
en: \bI'm a basic trainer with a Shadow Pokémon.
it: \bSono un Allenatore qualunque con un Pokémon Ombra.

id: You're too good for me!
en: You're too good for me!
it: Sei troppo forte per me!

id: \bDid you manage to snag my Shadow Pokémon? Because you can't battle me again for another chance.
en: \bDid you manage to snag my Shadow Pokémon?  Because you can't battle me again for another chance.
it: \bSei riuscito a catturare il mio Pokémon Ombra?  Perché non potrai sfidarmi di nuovo per avere un'altra occasione.

id: \rYou can battle me repeatedly, and have unlimited attempts to snag my Shadow Pokémon.
en: \rYou can battle me repeatedly, and have unlimited attempts to snag my Shadow Pokémon.
it: \rPuoi sfidarmi tutte le volte che vuoi e hai tentativi illimitati per catturare il mio Pokémon Ombra.

id: \rYou've managed to snag my Shadow Electabuzz. I'm not going to do anything now.
en: \rYou've managed to snag my Shadow Electabuzz.  I'm not going to do anything now.
it: \rSei riuscito a catturare il mio Electabuzz Ombra.  Ora non farò più niente.

id: \bI can tell you some things about Shadow Pokémon in Essentials. However, the wiki has far more information about them.
en: \bI can tell you some things about Shadow Pokémon in Essentials.  However, the wiki has far more information about them.
it: \bPosso dirti qualcosa sui Pokémon Ombra in Essentials.  Però la wiki contiene molte più informazioni.

id: \bWhat do you want to know?
en: \bWhat do you want to know?
it: \bCosa vuoi sapere?

id: \bShadow Pokémon are a special kind of Pokémon which appeared in Pokémon Colosseum and Pokémon XD.
en: \bShadow Pokémon are a special kind of Pokémon which appeared in Pokémon Colosseum and Pokémon XD.
it: \bI Pokémon Ombra sono un tipo speciale di Pokémon apparso in Pokémon Colosseum e Pokémon XD.

id: \bThey can be included in Essentials as well. See the wiki for information on how to do this.
en: \bThey can be included in Essentials as well.  See the wiki for information on how to do this.
it: \bSi possono includere anche in Essentials.  Consulta la wiki per sapere come fare.

id: \bTrainers with Shadow Pokémon are set up in exactly the same way as any other trainer.
en: \bTrainers with Shadow Pokémon are set up in exactly the same way as any other trainer.
it: \bGli Allenatori con Pokémon Ombra si configurano esattamente come qualsiasi altro allenatore.

id: \bAny Poké Ball can be defined as a Snag Ball in items.txt. If $PokemonGlobal.snagMachine is TRUE, all Poké Balls will be Snag Balls automatically.
en: \bAny Poké Ball can be defined as a Snag Ball in items.txt.  If $PokemonGlobal.snagMachine is TRUE, all Poké Balls will be Snag Balls automatically.
it: \bQualsiasi Poké Ball può essere definita come Snag Ball in items.txt.  Se $PokemonGlobal.snagMachine è TRUE, tutte le Poké Ball diventeranno automaticamente Snag Ball.

id: \b$Trainer.shadowcaught is an array (like the Pokédex seen/owned arrays) which keeps track of which Shadow Pokémon species have been caught.
en: \b$Trainer.shadowcaught is an array (like the Pokédex seen/owned arrays) which keeps track of which Shadow Pokémon species have been caught.
it: \b$Trainer.shadowcaught è un array (come gli array visti/catturati del Pokédex) che tiene traccia di quali specie di Pokémon Ombra sono state catturate.

id: \bYou can purify Shadow Pokémon in two ways.
en: \bYou can purify Shadow Pokémon in two ways.
it: \bPuoi purificare i Pokémon Ombra in due modi.

id: \bThe first is by bringing them to the Relic Stone here.
en: \bThe first is by bringing them to the Relic Stone here.
it: \bIl primo è portarli alla Pietra Reliquia qui.

id: \bThe second is by placing them in the Purify Chamber, which you can access from the PC in Poké Centers.
en: \bThe second is by placing them in the Purify Chamber, which you can access from the PC in Poké Centers.
it: \bIl secondo è metterli nella Camera di Purificazione, a cui puoi accedere dal PC dei Centri Pokémon.

id: \bI've now given you access to the Purify Chamber.
en: \bI've now given you access to the Purify Chamber.
it: \bTi ho appena dato accesso alla Camera di Purificazione.

id: \bThe effects of Heart Gauge-lowering items are already in Essentials. You just need to add the items themselves to items.txt.
en: \bThe effects of Heart Gauge-lowering items are already in Essentials.  You just need to add the items themselves to items.txt.
it: \bGli effetti degli strumenti che abbassano l'Indicatore Cuore sono già presenti in Essentials.  Devi solo aggiungere gli strumenti stessi a items.txt.

id: \bI can control the weather. Which weather would you like to see?\ch[1,-1,None,Rain,Storm, Snow,Sandstorm,Sunny,HeavyRain,Blizzard]
en: \bI can control the weather.  Which weather would you like to see?\ch[1,-1,None,Rain,Storm, Snow,Sandstorm,Sunny,HeavyRain,Blizzard]
it: \bPosso controllare il tempo atmosferico.  Quale tempo vorresti vedere?\ch[1,-1,Nessuno,Pioggia,Temporale, Neve,Tempesta sabbia,Sole,Diluvio,Bufera]

id: \bThis weather can occur even at night, and doesn't fade in/out. It's better if you don't use it.
en: \bThis weather can occur even at night, and doesn't fade in/out.  It's better if you don't use it.
it: \bQuesto tempo può verificarsi anche di notte e non ha dissolvenza in entrata/uscita.  È meglio non usarlo.

id: \bNote that the weather metadata for this map is set, even though its probability is 0. This prevents the weather from lingering when you leave this map.
en: \bNote that the weather metadata for this map is set, even though its probability is 0.  This prevents the weather from lingering when you leave this map.
it: \bNota che i metadati del tempo per questa mappa sono impostati, anche se la probabilità è 0.  Così si evita che il tempo persista quando lasci la mappa.

id: \bI stopped you as you walked past.
en: \bI stopped you as you walked past.
it: \bTi ho fermato mentre passavi.

id: \bHaving "Trainer(2)" as my event's name, and the "Event Touch" trigger, tells me to activate whenever you enter either of the two tiles in front of me.
en: \bHaving "Trainer(2)" as my event's name, and the "Event Touch" trigger, tells me to activate whenever you enter either of the two tiles in front of me.
it: \bAvere "Trainer(2)" come nome dell'evento e l'attivazione "Event Touch" mi fa attivare ogni volta che entri in una delle due caselle davanti a me.

id: \bKernel.pbExclaim makes me exclaim. Kernel.pbNoticePlayer does the same thing, as well as make me approach you.
en: \bKernel.pbExclaim makes me exclaim.  Kernel.pbNoticePlayer does the same thing, as well as make me approach you.
it: \bKernel.pbExclaim mi fa esclamare.  Kernel.pbNoticePlayer fa lo stesso e in più mi fa avvicinare a te.

id: \bTrainers use these features by default, but other NPCs like me can use them too. Roadblock events in particular love to use them.
en: \bTrainers use these features by default, but other NPCs like me can use them too.  Roadblock events in particular love to use them.
it: \bGli allenatori usano queste funzioni di default, ma anche altri PNG come me possono usarle.  Gli eventi di blocco stradale in particolare le adorano.

id: \bShall I turn you back like a real roadblock, or should I deactivate myself?
en: \bShall I turn you back like a real roadblock, or should I deactivate myself?
it: \bDevo rimandarti indietro come un vero blocco stradale, o preferisci che mi disattivi?

id: \bOkay. I'll fulfil my roadblock condition myself, by turning the Global Switch I depend on (5) to ON.
en: \bOkay.  I'll fulfil my roadblock condition myself, by turning the Global Switch I depend on (5) to ON.
it: \bVa bene.  Soddisferò da solo la mia condizione di blocco, attivando (ON) l'Interruttore Globale da cui dipendo (5).

id: \bRoadblock events don't normally set the conditions they wait for (Global Switch 5 in my case), but I did.
en: \bRoadblock events don't normally set the conditions they wait for (Global Switch 5 in my case), but I did.
it: \bDi solito gli eventi di blocco stradale non impostano le condizioni che attendono (l'Interruttore Globale 5 nel mio caso), ma io l'ho fatto.

id: \bHaiiiii-yaaaaaah!
en: \bHaiiiii-yaaaaaah!
it: \bHaiiiii-yaaaaaah!

id: \bYou won, good job.
en: \bYou won, good job.
it: \bHai vinto, bel lavoro.

id: You lost, too bad.
en: You lost, too bad.
it: Hai perso, peccato.

id: \bHello. This is what I say if you talk to me during the day.
en: \bHello.  This is what I say if you talk to me during the day.
it: \bCiao.  Questo è ciò che dico se mi parli durante il giorno.

id: \bHalt! Who goes there?
en: \bHalt!  Who goes there?
it: \bAlt!  Chi va là?

id: \bThis is what I say if you talk to me at night.
en: \bThis is what I say if you talk to me at night.
it: \bQuesto è ciò che dico se mi parli di notte.

id: Information
en: Information
it: Informazioni

id: Shadow Pokémon battles
en: Shadow Pokémon battles
it: Lotte Pokémon Ombra

id: Purifying Pokémon
en: Purifying Pokémon
it: Purificare Pokémon

id: Exit
en: Exit
it: Esci

id: Roadblock
en: Roadblock
it: Blocco stradale

id: Deactivate
en: Deactivate
it: Disattiva
